profile.headline: Software Engineer at HashiCorp, an IBM company
profile.summary:
With over 7 years of professional experience as a Front end focused software engineer 👨‍💻

I bring expertise in working with common web technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript & TypeScript, utilizing frameworks and libraries like Angular and React. 
In my previous roles, I also worked across the stack, using node for backend work and integrating Restful APIs into apps, as well as deploying apps to production & handling devops work with our CI/CD pipelines, reviewing collected analytics and environment monitoring.   

As one example from a recent position, I played a key role in building and enhancing systems that serve over 12 million users. 
Along with my regular tasks, I stepped up to the role as a POC for handing accessibility defects and working to mitigate any future ones as we continued to improve and add to our dashboard codebase.
Through working with accessibility partners, product owners and other developers on my team, we closed over 100 accessibility defects within 4 months since taking initiative; ensuring that our web pages are compliant with WCAG and more importantly accessible to our users that need it.

Alongside my technical skills, I have experience in project management, coordinating with stakeholders and team to meet project timelines and goals. This background enhances my ability to drive projects to completion and ensure that technical and business objectives align effectively.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as a front end developer across multiple teams, working in Angular & in React (Next.js) 

Experienced full stack process of creating new reusable components, hooking in APIs from Apigee & EPIC EHR and continuously deploying to production to provide top tier customer experience on our web pages.

Became a POC for handling user accessibility for my teams apps, leading regular meeting with a11y partners for maintaining standards & compliance

Implemented Axe core in GitHub pipeline to enable a precheck step for making sure any newly introduced code is tested for WCAG & ADA compliance

Applied automation testing for new code features with playwright & cucumber

positions.title: Community Ambassador of Off-Campus & Commuter Services
positions.description:
Be a point of contact for student residents on assigned off-campus blocks, provide access to resources, and aid in building a community to ease the transition to off-campus living.

Establish contact with residents of our block, serve on the off-campus student advisory council, create our own programming events, and participate in select OCCS programs.

positions.title: Main Desk Assistant
positions.description: Provide quality customer service to students, parents, and staff. Assist in opening and closing the residence hall, distributing mail and packages, answer phone calls, monitor established security systems and report problems, check out equipment, maintain appropriate records and handle monetary transactions.

positions.title: Specialty IT Intern
positions.description:
Researched and analyzed a 20+ year old legacy payment transaction system based in an oracle database and created detailed documentation and diagrams on the processing logic that were necessary for future projects to use for improving other existing systems.

Researched and produced reports on tokenization as a means to introduce new data encryption methods for a significant increase in PCI compliance with data transmission.

Created a new database in oracle along with a new UI using angular/prime-ng for the administrators in the IT department to use as a transition from maintaining employee information on spreadsheets and paper copies to maintaining them in a secure database. With this new and functional database, the administrators are able to work more effectively, easily maintain and access employee data, and be more readily available to help other employees in the IT department which also increases overall employee productivity.

positions.title: Head Camp Counselor
positions.description:
A Summer Program that serves children from diverse backgrounds including children who come
from low socioeconomic status or bilingual homes and/or who have social/emotional
needs or academic weaknesses.

Served as a co-leader of a dedicated group of children for a six week program that serves elementary children grades 1 to 5
Taught and mentored the Assistant Counselor to give direct guidance and instructions for maximum effectiveness

Supervised and assisted children in all of their activities with the goals of:
       -Promoting collaboration among children & staff
       -Establishing a mutual attitude of caring among all children & staff
       -Assisting children with acquiring new skills during their program blocks
       -Infusing all activities with fun

Served as a role model for children by:
      -Working as a team member with other counselors, assistant counselors and staff
      -Taking joy in learning new things with the children
      -Supporting a drug free, screen free, healthy environment

Swam with children and provided direct swimming instruction based upon training guidelines
Enforced the highest level of safety for children at all times

positions.title: Camp Counselor
positions.description:
Provided a safe and friendly environment for kids with positive role models, planned and lead
programs and activities in and out of the classroom for kids in small groups

Also provided campers with exposure to new places, experiences, and ideas through an integrated curriculum, trips, workshops and extracurricular events while at camp.

projects.title: Automatic Watering System Android App
projects.description: Android app that connects wirelessly using sockets to a server on a raspberry pi zero to control a watering system. The watering system uses moisture sensors to detect water moisture level in pots of soil, where if the moisture level detected is lower than a certain threshold the water pump will automatically turn on and once it reaches a certain moisture level the water pump automatically stops. The android app is able to control the watering system by connecting to the system, monitoring the moisture levels in real time and able to turn the water pump on and off using buttons.

projects.title: Healthcare Center Database
projects.description: For this project, I was tasked with designing, creating, implementing and testing a new healthcare center database. To do this, I took some common knowledge of how a hospital and or health center would typically be like in real life and I used some of the suggested information given about what a healthcare center typically requires and added on a bit more to get a general overview of what an actual health center database would function.
